correctness_confidence.basis: The core proof was reconstructed in the initial review; its mathematical environments are unchanged in this exact version. The additions are correct. rigor.basis: The proof is complete for connected independence-stable bases with at least one edge and uniform clique size at least two. The ground layer, first active coefficient block, profile compression and successive parameter limits support the six-state rank-two construction. The corrected version explicitly excludes the edgeless case and supplies the full-support Lorentzian criterion, inertia convention and matrix dimensions.

novelty.basis: Relative to the primary sources checked, the contribution is the uniform first active layer and compression to six states over this structural family. The conditioned-Hessian framework and abstract block form have antecedents. The added C6[K2] comparison identifies a case beyond the checked earlier criteria, while P3[K_s] correctly records overlap. Worldwide priority has not been exhaustively established.

significance.basis: A substantive specialized advance: an infinite structural family admits strictly positive rational rank-two antiferromagnetic targets using only six states. The result remains a partial obstruction theorem rather than a general classification; it proves neither six-state minimality nor useful quantitative parameter bounds.

reproducibility.basis: The unchanged supplement was reproduced in the initial review: 994 base cases, 360 stable bases, 720 blowups and four exact witnesses. Separate reviewer code and rational certificates are preserved. The follow-up verified artifact continuity, read and visually inspected all eight PDF pages, and checked the source diff and added claims. Unchanged computations were not rerun; there was no TeX rebuild or formal proof verification.

No unresolved material mathematical objection was found. All requested corrections from this reviewer's initial assessment are resolved. strengths: A constructive theorem covering an infinite family with a uniform bound of six spin states and rational strictly positive rank-two targets.
A transparent route from the minimum occupation layer to an invertible off-diagonal coefficient block and a four-dimensional restriction with two positive eigenvalues.
Exact reproducible witnesses, independent subset and Hessian checks, and a preserved negative control outside the hypotheses support the proof without replacing it.
The corrected PDF states its domain and conventions precisely, distinguishes its contribution from antecedents, and is legible on all eight pages.
weaknesses: The theorem is restricted to uniform clique blowups of independence-stable bases and does not settle the general classification problem.
Target parameters depend on the graph and clique size; no universal target, minimality of six states, or useful quantitative bounds are established.
Novelty is supported relative to the inspected primary sources, with acknowledged overlap and inherited methods; exhaustive worldwide priority was not verified.
